description: This file defines functions and types for constructing WebSocket payloads for OpenAI API interactions, including warm-up and response creation payloads, with configuration and utility functions.

methods.name: buildOpenAIWebSocketWarmUpPayload
methods.description: Constructs a WarmUpEvent payload with optional tools, instructions, and metadata.
